stage_r.generation_parameter_source: chosen for cross-study procedural comparability with the reasoning-anchor experiment; not claimed to be optimised for Qwen2.5
stage_r.marker_stop_rule: Sequence-aware stop on the complete marker string. Generation halts after the last token of the marker and before the next generated token, so the model never produces the A/B label used for the primary margin.
stage_r.seed_rule: seed_r = int.from_bytes(sha256(f'{base_seed}|{artifact_id}|{strictness_index}'.encode('utf-8')).digest()[:8], 'big') % 2147483647. Same convention as the reasoning-anchor study. SHA-256 is used because Python's built-in hash() is process-randomised and would not reproduce.
